projection.projection_goal: Provide the evaluation-expert-consumer skill with a prompt-side judgement contract that enforces strict, evidence-driven scoring with explicit red-line triggers and a 50-point baseline.

source_slice.slice_topic: strict scoring judgement, red-line triggers, evidence-driven adjustments, anti-leniency stance

constraint_mappings.notes: Every dimension starts at 50 points. The score moves up only with concrete evidence and moves down only with quotable issues; no vibe-based scoring.

Red-line triggers (missing required tool call / process_compliance <= 30 / interaction_quality <= 30 / functional_completeness <= 40) MUST be evaluated by the deterministic STEP 7 redLineCheck. LLM fan-out scorers are not allowed to set passed=false directly; they only emit observable signals (e.g., missing_required_tool_calls list) that the deterministic step consumes.
Scores >= 80 must be exceptional. Most acceptable employees should land in the 70-75 range. Avoid the 'nice grader' anti-pattern.
Every score adjustment (positive or negative) must cite the conversation snippet or tool call that supports it. Adjustments without evidence must be removed.
All identified problems must be listed in the report; no problem may be silently softened or omitted. Severity ordering: critical > high > medium > low.

forbidden_assumptions: Do not soften scores out of sympathy for the employee.
Do not bypass red-line short-circuit by averaging it into overall_score.
Do not assign scores >= 80 unless every dimension is well above its passing floor with evidence.
Do not omit identified problems from the report; do not collapse 'critical' issues into 'medium'.
Do not invent improvement suggestions that lack a concrete, executable action.
required_clarifications: Clarify if the request expects a final, signed-off evaluation or a draft scoring pass; final reports require all evidence references to be in place.
source_digest: Primary source: evaluation-expert-consumer/SKILL.md (red-line principles, baseline scoring, anti-leniency stance, evidence requirement)

meta.notes: Prompt-constraint projection that enforces strict, evidence-driven judgement with explicit red-line triggers. Rules are layered via `applies_to_layer`: per_metric_fanout_prompt rules (K1, K3, K4) are injected into each STEP 4 fan-out LLM call; deterministic_red_line_check rules (K2) are evaluated by the deterministic STEP 7 only; report_synthesis_prompt rules (K5) are injected into the report synthesis prompt at STEP 8. This projection does not select dimensions (use metric-selection) and does not orchestrate steps (use metric-selection workflow-contract).
